svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 540 x 420; round the corners to about 20 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slot for the hub: 120 wide from the bottom edge up to the axle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre (123.5 up from the bottom edge), ending in a 60 radius.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 6.6 mm holes for the rail tabs, 123.5 up from the bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge, 150 and 240 ahead of the axle line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left guard only: a 14 mm hole for the lock pin, 60 behind the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: axle line, 323.5 up from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make the right guard as a mirror image without the pin hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flat against the guard tabs on the rail, 5 mm outside the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail; two clips on the inner blade, 450 and 600 above ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit it before the wheel: the hub goes up into the slot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 15 mm or more from the spokes all round.
